semantics: Literal top-level or flat gestures category declarations. gesturep disables inhibition. Repeated mod:/scale: prefixes use the last value. Native scale is clamped to float32 0.1..10 for registration; raw finite normal input retained. cursorZoom arguments are zoom value then mode; scrollMove maps to the shared scroll_move label. Dispatcher name and comma-joined argument remain inert native text, no implicit Lua callbacks. Native/Lua registrations stay separate.
limits: No source variable/expression/include evaluation, qualified/other category syntax, unknown flags, arbitrary native prefix/hex/nonfinite numeric spellings, callback conversion, live input injection, effective/runtime gesture certification or live apply.
